# TildaZ v0.6.2

**More reliable input, clearer dialogs, and steadier desktop integration.**

v0.6.2 focuses on behavior you can see and feel: IME and tab-renaming input is
handled consistently, long dialogs remain usable, rendering is more stable,
and launch/install paths behave more predictably across Linux, macOS, and
Windows. The config schema is unchanged.

## Input and IME reliability

- Input composed with a Korean, Japanese, or Chinese IME is committed exactly
  once before state-changing shortcuts. On macOS this now also covers the
  About, Open Config, Open Log, and Quit menu paths; cancelling Quit does not
  duplicate the committed text. ([#313](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/313),
  [#317](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/317))
- Pasting while renaming a tab now stays in the tab name instead of leaking to
  the background shell. Navigation keys are likewise contained, while
  read-only Copy and performance shortcuts leave the rename session intact.
- F2 through F12 now reach terminal applications on Linux and Windows, so TUI
  programs such as `htop` and `mc` can use their normal function-key bindings.
- Ctrl+C reaches the active terminal promptly on every platform, including
  while output is busy.

## Dialogs and rendering

- Linux, macOS, and Windows dialogs now use the TildaZ icon and a shared branded
  layout. Short messages remain compact; long About, config, and shell errors
  scroll only their body while keeping the title and actions visible. Long
  paths and diagnostic details are no longer truncated or silently omitted.
  ([#314](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/314))
- The macOS confirmation dialog now accepts its first Enter or Esc reliably.
  ([#249](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/249))
- OSC 11 background-color changes now cover the entire frame, blank cells, and
  inactive tabs instead of leaving areas in the configured theme color.
- Wide CJK glyphs are centered consistently on macOS and Windows, and cached
  ligature shaping keeps repeated rendering, scrolling, and resizing stable.
- Windows opacity below 100% now uses DirectComposition. Transparent windows no
  longer disappear or crash, and fullscreen toggles no longer conflict with
  DXGI's built-in Alt+Enter handling. ([#89](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/89))

## Launch and desktop reliability

- Concurrent autostart and normal launches now wait for an instance endpoint
  to become ready before sending a request. Requests are no longer lost during
  startup, and Windows launch bursts no longer create duplicate instance
  prompts. ([#301](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/301),
  [#304](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/304))
- Linux mixed-monitor setups now derive geometry and scale from the output that
  actually contains the drop-down. This fixes wrong sizing or blur across
  different resolutions/scales and removes a high-CPU recreate loop on sway.
  ([#295](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/295))
- Linux can fall back to an installed system font for characters outside the
  configured font chain. A specifically configured but missing family now
  produces a clear startup error instead of silently changing the primary
  font. ([#289](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/289))
- Linux login startup now respects each instance's `auto_start` setting, quotes
  executable paths containing spaces, and reports an invalid startup shell
  before opening a terminal. ([#283](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/283))

## Upgrade notes

- Linux uninstall now removes TildaZ hotkey registrations while preserving
  config and logs unless purge is requested.
- The macOS artifact now uses a stable self-signed TildaZ identity instead of
  an ad-hoc signature. Existing users may need to approve Input Monitoring and
  Accessibility once when moving to v0.6.2, but the stable identity prevents
  the permission identity from changing on every release. The app is still not
  Apple-notarized, so the documented first-launch Gatekeeper steps still apply.
- Config lookup now follows `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` consistently. An absolute value is
  used directly; an empty or relative value falls back to the platform's normal
  per-user config location.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux portable (glibc 2.28+) | `tildaz-v0.6.2-linux-{x86_64,aarch64}.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh`; no `sudo`. |
| Linux Debian / Ubuntu | `tildaz_0.6.2_{amd64,arm64}.deb` | Install with `dpkg` or a graphical software installer. |
| Linux Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE | `tildaz-0.6.2-1.{x86_64,aarch64}.rpm` | Install with `dnf` or the distro package tool. |
| Linux distro-independent | `TildaZ-0.6.2-{x86_64,aarch64}.AppImage` | Make executable and run; FUSE is optional. |
| Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS | `tildaz-0.6.2-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | x86_64 package. |
| macOS 14+ universal | `tildaz-v0.6.2-macos.dmg` | Apple Silicon and Intel; stable self-signed identity, not notarized. |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `tildaz-v0.6.2-win-x64.zip` | Includes the bundled ConPTY runtime. |
| Windows 11 ARM64 | `tildaz-v0.6.2-win-arm64.zip` | ARM64-native binary and ConPTY runtime. |
